dataset_name: Indian Agro-Climatic Multi-Season Crop Suitability Dataset

sources.name: Directorate of Economics & Statistics (DES), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
sources.description: Area, Production and Yield (APY) agricultural statistics across Indian states & districts.

sources.name: ICRISAT District-Level Database (DLD)
sources.description: Longitudinal crop production and biophysical environmental data across 311 districts.

sources.name: ICAR-IISS & DAC&FW Soil Health Card Scheme
sources.description: National soil fertility benchmarks for N, P, K, pH, Organic Carbon, and EC across agro-climatic zones.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Climatology & Forecasts
sources.description: Meteorological parameters (temperature, precipitation series, soil moisture, ET0).

sources.name: Open-Elevation & Geo AI Erosion Pipeline
sources.description: Ground elevation, slope, and XGBoost erosion risk context.

leakage_controls.temporal: Historical training records strictly use observation-year meteorological and agronomic features. Live forecast data is applied exclusively at inference time for current operational ranking.
leakage_controls.spatial: Supports both stratified random split and geographic agro-climatic zone grouped cross-validation.
